title: Coldkey – Post-quantum age key generation and paper backup tool
summary: Coldkey is a post-quantum cryptographic key generation tool that allows users to create quantum-resistant keys and backup them onto paper for long-term cold storage. It addresses the emerging need for quantum-safe encryption in an era where traditional RSA/ECC keys may become vulnerable to quantum attacks.
problem_solved: Provides quantum-resistant key generation with physical paper backup for secure, long-term key storage that won't be compromised by future quantum computers.
why_valuable: As quantum computing advances, traditional encryption becomes vulnerable; Coldkey offers a practical solution for generating and preserving quantum-safe keys in an offline, physically durable format.
